how_to_apply: Visit the official Bhadradri Kothagudem district website at kothagudem.telangana.gov.in.
Open the recruitment notification for 95 NHM/NUHM contract and outsourcing posts.
Download Recruitment Notification No. 01/2026 and both vacancy annexures.
Read the vacancy list carefully and select the post for which you meet the prescribed eligibility requirements.
Download the official application form.
Fill in the post name, personal details, date of birth, contact information and category details.
Enter the required Class 1 to Class 7 study information for local-status verification.
Fill in the educational and technical qualification details.
Enter the relevant professional council registration number and date, where applicable.
Provide the marks obtained in the basic qualifying examination.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign as instructed.
Attach self-attested copies of the required educational, age, study, caste and professional certificates.
Obtain a Demand Draft of Rs. 1,000 from a nationalized bank in favour of District Medical and Health Officer, Bhadradri Kothagudem.
Enter the Demand Draft number, date, amount and bank name in the application form.
Enclose the original Demand Draft with the completed application.
Review the form and all supporting documents.
Submit the application directly or by Registered Post to the DM&HO office, IDOC Complex, Palvancha.
Ensure that the application is received by 13 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Retain a copy of the completed application and postal receipt or office acknowledgement.
Important: The application form is downloaded online, but the completed application must be submitted offline. Do not treat downloading the form as an online application submission.
important_instructions: The recruitment covers a total of 95 NHM/NUHM vacancies. The 95 posts consist of 68 vacancies in the first annexure and 27 in the second. The recruitment notification was issued on 6 November 2026. Applications are accepted from 9 November 2026 at 10:30 AM. The deadline is 13 November 2026 at 5:00 PM. Applications must be submitted offline, directly or by Registered Post. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 1 July 2026, before relaxation. Eligible SC, ST, BC and EWS candidates receive five years of age relaxation. PwD candidates receive ten years of age relaxation, subject to the applicable rules. Selection is based on a 100-mark merit evaluation. The qualifying examination carries 90 marks. Age weightage carries a maximum of 10 marks. Local-status and reservation requirements apply. The application fee is Rs. 1,000 by Demand Draft. The Demand Draft must be drawn in favour of the District Medical and Health Officer, Bhadradri Kothagudem. Self-attested supporting certificates must accompany the application. Class 1 to Class 7 study records are relevant for local-status determination. Posts are sanctioned under different health programmes and units. Monthly remuneration differs by post and programme. The appointments are on a contract/outsourcing basis. Candidates should check the official website for further recruitment updates.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Bhadradri Kothagudem Vacancy 2026 - 95 Posts
content_sections.text: The recruitment covers 95 contract/outsourcing vacancies sanctioned under two NHM vacancy annexures for Bhadradri Kothagudem District. The first annexure includes 68 approved vacancies under Child Health, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, National Urban Health Mission, RBSK, tuberculosis control and other health programmes. Remuneration Clarification: The first annexure lists alternative designations and remuneration in certain rows, including Paediatrician/Medical Officer and MLHP/CHO/MO. These are combined vacancy entries, not separate additional vacancies for every designation. The applicable remuneration depends on the position and conditions approved for engagement. The annexure also contains programme-specific remarks for some MLHP and NUHM vacancies. Candidates should verify the current establishment and engagement conditions before applying. The second annexure, dated 19 September 2026, approves another 27 contract vacancies for Child Health, Maternal Health, Infrastructure Human Resources and related health programmes. The following summary combines similar designations from both annexures to help candidates understand the vacancy distribution. Alternative or combined designations remain grouped as shown in the official documents. Important: The combined table is an editorial grouping of the two official annexures. Applicants should identify the exact programme unit and designation before submitting the prescribed application form.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Bhadradri Kothagudem Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be made strictly on merit using a 100-mark evaluation system . The score comprises 90 marks for the basic qualifying examination and 10 marks for age weightage. The recruitment notification awards 0.5 marks for each completed year of age from 18 years , up to a maximum of 10 marks, calculated as on 1 July 2026. For example, a candidate aged 28 completed years would receive 5 age-weightage marks, while a candidate aged 38 or older would reach the maximum age weightage of 10 marks. The age-weightage score is added to the qualifying-examination component to calculate the merit score out of 100. The recruitment notice prescribes selection based on qualifying-examination marks and age weightage. It does not announce a separate written examination in the stated selection criteria. The selection list will be prepared following the applicable Rule of Reservation, Presidential Orders relating to local status and the notified provisions for women's reservation. The notice refers to 33 1/3% reservation for women under G.O. Ms. No. 3 dated 10 February 2024. Local status is determined using the prescribed study records, including Class 1 to Class 7 study certificates, in accordance with the applicable Presidential Order.
